runtime_controls: Fresh temporary git project; no game files copied
Fixed wildcard PreToolUse deny hook; hook-ready check
Strict deny rules for commands, file reads/writes, web and MCP
Reject all tool/subagent activity and unsupported stream events
Single final JSON object; no ambiguous concatenation
Prompt on stdin; shell:false; child environment excludes provider API keys
Parent deadline and CLI print-timeout; process-group cleanup; explicit shutdown cancellation
Two concurrent calls maximum; existing tutor gate, retry and offline fallback
limitations: The authenticated CLI retains its real HOME and may automatically load the user’s global agy rules, skills metadata, plugins or preferences. This is not an exclusive-context model transport.
The game sends only its whitelisted tutor request; the temporary cwd contains no repository source or solution files, and model-requested access is denied.
The CLI may retain its own conversation records according to the user’s agy settings. Runtime temporary workspaces are deleted.
Custom agent inheritance isolation was explored but did not preserve the explicit deny hook reliably on this installation; it is not used.
